title: No cut vertex forces connectivity at least two
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on a vertex set with at least three vertices. If $G$ is connected and has no cut vertex, then its vertex connectivity satisfies $\kappa(G) \ge 2$.
replaced:
Core of the block criterion: a connected graph on at least three vertices
with no cut vertex has \texttt{$\kappa$ $\ge$ 2}.
